intros.title: The room is spinning too fast
intros.subtitle: Take a breath with me!

intros.title: Too many doors, too many directions?
intros.subtitle: Pick just this one moment

intros.title: Feeling shrunk by the weight of everything?
intros.subtitle: Let's make some space

intros.title: when the world gets curiouser and louder...
intros.subtitle: hit pause for a second

activities.prompt: Everything feels huge right now. Write the ONE single task that actually matters to you in the next 15 minutes.
Name 3 physical objects within arm's reach right now to ground yourself in this room
Empty your entire mental to-do list onto this scroll so your brain doesn't have to hold it anymore

outros: You don't have to solve all of Wonderland today, just take the very next step
One small door at a time is more than enough
You've caught your breath. Now step back out whenever you're ready
You are always the exact right size for the moment you are in

intros.title: Too hot to think straight?
intros.subtitle: Step off the throne for a moment

intros.title: Your royal temper is boiling over!
intros.subtitle: Take a breath, Your Majesty

intros.title: Ready to shout 'Off with their heads!'?
intros.subtitle: Let's cool that fire first

activities.prompt: Write the brutally honest, unsent royal decree you want to shout right now. Don't filter it (this disappears forever)
Finish this sentence honestly: I am seeing red right now because...
Write down the one person, thing, or expectation you need to step away from for 10 minutes

outros: True royalty doesn't need to shout to command the room. Walk out with your crown steady
You set the heat down before it burned you. That is real power.
Take a deep breath, straighten your crown, and move forward unbothered
Strength isn't the storm, it's the calm that remains after it passes

intros.title: Fading into a loop of 'what ifs'?
intros.subtitle: Let's bring you back to focus

intros.title: Your mind is chasing its own tail
intros.subtitle: Pause and vanish the noise

intros.title: Overthinking every possible path?
intros.subtitle: None of them matter right now

intros.title: When your thoughts start multiplying like shadows...
intros.subtitle: turn on the light

activities.prompt: Summarize the exact 'what if' loop spinning in your head in 5 words or fewer
Write down the worst-case scenario your brain is inventing, then write one ridiculous, absurd best-case scenario right below it
Look away from your screen and write down the weirdest or most specific sound you can hear right now

outros: The fog has cleared, and all that's left is right here, right now
Tomorrow's puzzles don't belong to this minute. Leave them in the dark
You don't need to know the whole map to take one clear step
Not every riddle needs an answer, some just need to fade away

intros.title: Stuck in a frantic loop?
intros.subtitle: Declare an un-birthday break right now!

intros.title: No rush, no rules, no ticking clocks
intros.subtitle: Just your breath

intros.title: Put the pocket watch away!
intros.subtitle: You have all the time you need

intros.title: Chasing seconds that haven't happened yet?
intros.subtitle: Come back to the present

activities.prompt: Time is frozen at this tea party. Write down one thing you are rushing that can actually wait
Dump every frantic, racing thought ticking in your head onto the table right now.
Write down one physical tension you're holding right now and drop it

outros: Time works for you now, not against you. Take the rest of your day slowly
Tea is finished, nerves are settled, and you are right on time
Consider this your official Un-Birthday permission to take things easy
You don't have to wind yourself up to survive today. Stay loose
